name: Nagarjuna Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Nagarjuna Fertilizers 
and Chemicals Ltd manufactures and markets Fertilizers, Micro Irrigation Equipments and Agri Informatic Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NFCL is a flagship company of the Nagarjuna Group. Andhra Pradesh State Government and FIIs are the major shareholders of the company. It is an ISO 9001:2000 certified manufacturer and supplier of plant nutrients in India. Besides manufacturing, NFCL trades Urea (Government Pool Urea), Specialty Fertilizers, and Agriinputs [viz. Muriate of Potash (MOP), Diammonium Phosphate 
 (DAP), NPK etc. Company also deals in the micro irrigation business and PVC pipe manufacturing.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -16.2% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 37.6% of their holding.
Debtor days have increased from 60.9 to 123 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
